title: Incorrect header name normalisation
detail: The logic sets the header name to "Content-Type" when the incoming name is not "content-type", which overwrites all other headers and mis‑names the Content-Type header. This causes the client to send malformed headers and can break server parsing.
note: Describes the planted flip: every other header is renamed to Content-Type.

title: Missing timeout on network request
detail: The POST request has no timeout or error handling, so a hanging or slow server can cause the client to block indefinitely.
